source_dependency: construction/proposed_pr_source.py (EC161, strengthened provider IDs in EC162)

github.base_sha: base.sha (base branch tip at observation, NOT merge base)
github.additional_checks: base.repo.full_name matches requested path; head.repo.full_name required; merged cannot be true if state open
github.unavailable_when: head.repo missing/deleted, full SHA missing, repo/number mismatch, metadata inconsistent

gitlab.merge_base_sha: diff_refs.base_sha (merge base, NOT target branch tip)
gitlab.target_tip_sha: diff_refs.start_sha (target commit of that diff version, NOT necessarily live branch tip)
gitlab.additional_checks: top-level sha when present equals diff_refs.head_sha; project_id when present equals target_project_id; references.full when present matches requested project!iid
gitlab.unavailable_when: asynchronous missing diff_refs/start_sha/source_project_id or mixed SHA lengths, project/reference mismatch

pin.domain_separated_fingerprint: sha256:hex(SHA256(ASCII 'CES-EC162-PROVIDER-METADATA-PIN-v1\0' || canonical JSON sorted keys compact ASCII))
pin.fingerprint_authentication: NONE; detects accidental drift/corruption only and can be recomputed by any party
pin.expected_pin: previous complete ces.proposed_pr_identity.v1 JSON output, read-only, <=65536 bytes
pin.differences_invalidate: repository target/source/PR ID; locator or GH source path; cross-fork; exact base/head/target tip SHA; object algorithm; semantics; provider state/merged report; synthetic vs live
pin.changed_fields: names only, no old/new SHA values or raw provider text
pin.not_used: branch names, temporary PR refs, author display name/email, target HEAD name

local_git.mode: OPTIONAL; --local-git absolute directory, only when caller explicitly asks
local_git.input: Full exact base/head/target-tip hexadecimal commit OIDs via stdin, never refs
local_git.privacy: no stdout/stderr of Git or pathname in structured result
local_git.safeguards: 5-second timeout, no optional locks/config overrides/replacement objects; GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1; GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=empty; no shell/hook/checkout/refs/index writes

output.success_meaning: same provider-claimed pin at two observations + all local commit OIDs exist in supplied Git object database + not synthetic; does NOT attest remote repo identity, race-free snapshot, merge/delivery or write eligibility
output.partial_meaning: single provider claim, fixture/injected transport, absent previous pin, missing/unverified local commits, or prior match without local object check
output.unavailable_meaning: input Provider read unavailable/inconsistent, or previously expected source facts drifted
output.returned_pin_when: source metadata shaped, provider IDs+SHAs complete and prior absent/matched; withheld on source error or pin drift
output.sensitive_fields_never_emitted: token, header, PR title/body/author, diff/patch, file path listing, raw API payload, raw subprocess stderr, local Git path
